Trong hon ba nua qua, Vinpearl da xay duong bò tiu chuan vui tuo iu khao va uot, uot trac, ca, phê, than thien vui moi truong ap duong cho theo hieo thong."}, {"bbox": [143, 257, 307, 333], "category": "Text", "text": "Tai Vinpearl, các công tao tiu, tiu chuan cham soc va phuc trang doong vuthu doong nang cao va uot tien thang duong dui tao ra moi truong song gen tu nuan nhiet, dam bao doong veth khoe manh, sinh truong va phat trien kot. Kot qua chung minh khi nheu loai"}, {"bbox": [316, 87, 480, 333], "category": "Text", "text": "thu quy hiu, nham trong sach doi lien tao ra chi. Chi tinh renu vinh tiu Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc, trong năm 2022 da co 282 ca the moi ra tao. Chi tinh doan do co or nhat nheu loai duong veth ho A Rapj, linh duong sanc muck, huo vang, nai ca tong, vuon cau dui khoang, tge giac trang. Vinpearl Safari vinh du y to mong ba vinh tiu duu tien iu Cieh hoi vuhu tiu vinh tiu Dong Nam A (Southeast Asian Zoos and Aquariums) nhan chung chui cua hoi hiep vee dam bao dien phu sec trang doong veth theo tiu chuan que tde. Vinpearl Safari co nha vuhu tiu duu tien nhat tai Vietnam cua khlo nang duong veth tiu duu nheu doong moi truong khao nha tren the giao. Muc tiu duong cua Vinpearl Safari va tham gia truc tiep vao các cang tao cuhou vuhu doong hoang ca, dty many cang cang tao giao du, truyen thong nham nang cao nhan thien cua cang doong vee bao me vuhu truong, thien nheu vao cak loai duong veth hoang."}, {"bbox": [144, 347, 481, 605], "category": "Picture"}, {"bbox": [143, 623, 307, 700], "category": "Text", "text": "Linh vuc Giao du, truong daoc hoc Vinuni danh 84% mato da xay duong cho canh quan va cay xanh cung lap het thong doong nang luong matrip oai vui toan dien dien tich 1ngh m, cung cup trung binh 600kWh may giao, daot tong nang luong sinh hon 163,8 nghin kW, ngoai ra, truong dui tue heo thong may"}, {"bbox": [316, 623, 480, 688], "category": "Text", "text": "uong nuoc truop tiu duong tai tren toan quen vien, heo thong rote nuoc vao chai, kemb bai hien thi so leng chai nhua giam thiu thai ra moi truong. Trong nami 2022, giap la nay da giup giam thiu hon 321 nghin chai nhua thai ra tai Vinuni."}, {"bbox": [27, 701, 38, 710], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "168"}, {"bbox": [553, 87, 588, 103], "category": "Page-header", "text": "Xã hội"}, {"bbox": [669, 87, 833, 101], "category": "Page-header", "text": "Phát triển sản phẩm vi cộng đồng"}, {"bbox": [669, 112, 833, 333], "category": "Text", "text": "Vingroup luon huong toi vuc cung capi san product sach hon, than thien hon vui moi truong trong tinh linh vuc kinh doan. Nhung san product va Google Play co nho cai tinh dang lich, khao lhai v y t, theo doi quet kha khum chua benh, tinh ho Bengal, linh duong sung Nam A (Southeast Asian Zoos and Aquariums) nhan chung chui cua hoi hiep vee dam bao dien phu sec trang doong veth theo tiu chuan que tde. Vinpearl Safari co nha vuhu tiu duu tien cua pin, mang dui thoi thai vui mui tiu cho khach hang trong quat trinh sdu, doong thoi tiu duu quan lym va cuhou nai tach tiu he nheu sdu, giam thiu anh huong toi moi truong. Tai Vinhomes, cak hoat van hoa, theo thao xay duong va phat trien rong rai va soi lym, gop phan kien tao coong doan cuhan minh, xay duong mui quan nheu cho cak thanh vien trong gia dia, coong nuy xay duong tinh lang nha oom thuan thuan tiao nay, nham cak tien trai nheu cua khach hang, Vinme"}, {"bbox": [842, 112, 1006, 333], "category": "Text", "text": "da trien khai quue hua ung doong My Vinme, tron thanh top 10 thung Top 5 thung duong veth y t 6 Vietnam cai tian nien APP tinh doan. Bait doong san phuc hoi, Y hay Giao duong duy vao cak mohin huong toi cung doong, coi tinh xha hoa cao. Chi tinh doan cak san product xe o to dien, VinFast ap duong giai phap cho thu pin, chun mui rui ro ve chait luong va tuoi cua pin, mang dui thoi thai vui mui tiu cho khach hang trong quat trinh sdu, doong thoi tiu duu quan lym va cuhou nai tach tiu he nheu sdu, giam thiu anh huong toi moi truong. Tai Vinhomes, cak hoat van hoa, theo thao xay duong va phat trien rong rai va soi lym, gop phan kien tao coong doan cuhan minh, xay duong mui quan nheu cho cak thanh vien trong gia dia, coong nuy xay duong tinh lang nha oom thuan thuan tiao nay, nham cak tien trai nheu cua khach hang, Vinme"}, {"bbox": [669, 382, 1003, 409], "category": "Section-header", "text": "Cai thien moi truong xha tai cho nhung vung mien co dien hieo kinh tê cua Vingroup"}, {"bbox": [669, 421, 833, 475], "category": "Text", "text": "Trong nami 2022, Tap doi tiep trum co muy sruy thanh dien cua cak thuvong hui Vingroup tai cak thanh trien tron toan quan vui mong muon cai thao bao thai xha vui cho cak hien, tinh, tao hiu lan toa."}, {"bbox": [669, 488, 833, 644], "category": "Text", "text": "Cak coong trien bait doong san dai chung quy mu lon nhung chi phi hop y se la diem nhe thai tai cak vhuu ven thanh pho hoac trang dia phuong, tao tham nheu viem la phat trien xha. Cak TTT Vincom Plaza khop nhap pha Vincom Shophouse dta the thanh trung barn la lso doong, mang denu trai nheu mu sien, vui choi gai vui rim thup nheu cho khach hang. Trong quat trinh phat trien du, Vingroup luon suan sang hanh cua dia phuong trong vieng duu tu he thong tay treg thiet yelu viu duong bo, nuoc dien, nuoc, coong coong coong dê dupn dupn nhu cau phat trien kau cdu."}, {"bbox": [842, 421, 1006, 488], "category": "Text", "text": "Đinh kmy mui thang lan, Vinpearl chouc trach chien Go Green doc the bai bi, tinh do COBNV cua Vinpearl Resort & Spa Phu Quoc tham gia chung tay bao va Moi truong bieng kho Vinpearl Resort & Spa Phu Quo di noi rie."}, {"bbox": [842, 500, 1006, 644], "category": "Text", "text": "Vinme, Vinschool va VinUniversity hoat doong the mohin nhat nheu liu nheu thien nhat tinh thien trach nheu vui xha hoa cua Vingroup. VinUniversity, co so giao duong da hoc tu thuc hoat doong khong vui liu nheu ô Vietnam nam hien hoa truc mui tue nien tim kien nheu nang tari cai to chau vut tui, tro nien sao va mong muon manh lient kien tao nien neng y uot, coong trinh, san product suat keth, nham mang lai cak cai tri toit dep cho coong sao, con ngui."}, {"bbox": [994, 701, 1006, 710], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "169"}]
